subject: Customer impact briefing — discovery interview scheduling & recording consent
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@zenrite.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Customer impact briefing — discovery interview scheduling & recording consent

Hi Liam —

Thanks again for agreeing to participate in a short case study with Redwood Inference. We want to keep this lightweight: a 45-minute discovery interview with a few stakeholders to capture the business context, measurable outcomes, and get permission to record a short on-camera testimonial (optional).

Proposed agenda (attached as a one-pager):
- 5 min: introductions & objectives
- 15 min: background on Zenrite's LLM use cases and success criteria
- 15 min: results / outcomes (latency, cost, reliability, product impact)
- 5 min: customer quotes and next steps
- 5 min: recording wrap / permissions

Could you confirm:
1) Which stakeholders should join from your side (product / infra / legal ok)?
2) Two or three 45-minute slots next week that work for you — we're PST-based but can shift.
3) Whether Zenrite is comfortable with a short recording of the call and a separate optional 2–3 minute on-camera customer quote (we'll send a release form).

Attachments: zenrite_case-study_agenda_v1.pdf (agenda), media-release-template.docx (draft release)

If you prefer, we can run the interview with just one product leader and an engineer and do a follow-up for the on-camera piece.

Thanks,
Olga
Customer Marketing | Redwood Inference

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@zenrite.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Zenrite Product Team <product@zenrite.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Customer impact briefing — discovery interview scheduling & recording consent

Hi Olga —

Appreciate the clear agenda — looks great. Quick answers below:

1) Stakeholders:
- Me (Head of Product)
- Priya Desai (Senior ML Engineer)
- Marco Reyes (Infra Lead) — optional for deep infra questions

2) Slots (PST):
- Tue 16 Mar 2027, 10:00–10:45
- Wed 17 Mar 2027, 14:00–14:45
- Thu 18 Mar 2027, 09:30–10:15 (tight)

We prefer Wed 17th 14:00 PST.

3) Recording: Zenrite is fine with recording the discovery call for Redwood's internal production and the case write-up. For any on-camera short testimonial, we'll need to review the release form and run it by Legal. You can send the finalized release and we'll try to fast-track approval.

Thanks,
Liam
Head of Product — Zenrite

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@zenrite.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Customer impact briefing — discovery interview scheduling & recording consent

Thanks — locking in Wed 17 Mar, 14:00–14:45 PST. I'll send the calendar invite and the draft questions. Olga, can you add the two attachments (agenda + release) to the invite and ask Liam which Zoom account they prefer? Also flag the interview notes owner and the follow-up deliverables:

- Interview notes + 1-page summary (Marissa)
- Technical follow-up to Priya (Ben)
- Media release review (Olga)

Ben — can you prepare a short list of 3 technical metrics we should confirm in the call (e.g., p50 latency under 20ms, token cost delta after quantization, outage history) and include them in the doc? Keep it conversational — we want concrete numbers but avoid heavy auditing on the call.

Marissa
Customer Marketing | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@zenrite.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Customer impact briefing — discovery interview scheduling & recording consent

Marissa / Olga —

Added the quick tech checklist below; I'll paste into the invite and keep it high-level as requested:
- Production p50 and p95 inference latency (typical prompt length)
- Average token cost before/after optimizations (month-over-month or per-request sample)
- Percent of requests served from cache / hit rate (if available)
- Any SLO breaches or notable incidents in the last 6 months (brief)

Liam — thanks for confirming the slot. For the recording/release: Olga, please send the media-release-template.docx with a short note that Legal can redline; we'll mark the call as recorded in the invite but the on-camera piece will be scheduled post-approval.

Cheers,
Ben
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
